info.name: Wellness User App — Complete Flow
info.description:
User App API collection organized by onboarding flow:

**Seek → PWC → Zoom Call → Energy Exchange → Client Payment → Profile Settings**

## Flow overview
1. **Seek** — Register with health concern + optional referral code (WC/AWC assignment)
2. **PWC** — Consultancy payment (application subscription by health concern)
3. **Zoom Call** — Zoom link created after consultancy payment; view via transaction detail
4. **Heal Subscription** — Full Heal tier unlock (required for most wellness features)
5. **Energy Exchange** — Coach enables program; user previews, orders, and pays
6. **Client Payment** — Coach-triggered App Program checkout (optional)
7. **Paid Onboarding** — Post-subscription profile setup
8. **Profile Settings** — Update profile, phone, WhatsApp

## Setup
- Import `Wellness-API.postman_environment.json`
- Set `baseUrl` (default: `http://localhost:5000/api`)
- Configure Cashfree keys in Admin → Configs → Payment gateway

## Auth
User auth endpoints auto-save `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to collection variables.

## Staff prerequisites (folder A)
Some steps require coach/admin actions (enable Energy Exchange, trigger program checkout, assign coach). Use folder **A - Staff Prerequisites** when testing end-to-end.

item.name: 01 - Seek (Registration & Login)
item.description: Free-tier user registration. Optional `referralCode` assigns WC/AWC at registration. `primaryHealthConcern` is required.

request.description: Sends OTP to WhatsApp. In dev with EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true, OTP is in response as debugOtp.
Creates Seek-tier account. Saves accessToken. referralCode optional for WC/AWC assignment.

item.name: 02 - PWC (Consultancy / Application Subscription)
item.description: Seek-to-Heal consultancy payment. User selects health concern, pays consultancy fee. On success: tier becomes consultancy_only, WC/AWC assigned (via referral or pending_admin), Zoom meeting created.

request.description: Preview pricing with optional referral discount.
Creates Cashfree order. Saves consultancyTransactionId and payment_order_id.
Verify payment. User tier → consultancy_only. Zoom meeting scheduled.

item.name: 03 - WC/AWC Assignment (View)
item.description: Coach assignment happens automatically at registration (referral code) or consultancy payment. Admin can also assign via staff APIs. User views assignment via profile.

request.description: Check assignedCoachId, assignedCoachType, parentCoachId, assignmentStatus, userTier.

item.name: 04 - Zoom Call
item.description: After consultancy payment, a Zoom meeting is auto-created. Join URL is in the consultancy transaction. Heal consultancy tracks available after Heal subscription.

request.description: Response includes zoomMeetingLink and zoomMeetingId on paid transactions.
Request a consultancy track session. Requires Heal tier.
List consultancy booking tracks. Requires Heal tier.

item.name: 05 - Heal Subscription (Full Access)
item.description: After consultancy (PWC), user upgrades to full Heal tier. Required to unlock most wellness features.

item.name: 06 - Energy Exchange Program
item.description: WC enables Energy Exchange program for client (see Staff Prerequisites). User previews FY plans, creates order, and pays.

request.description: Current EE program config for user. enabled=false until coach enables.

item.name: 07 - Client Payment (Coach Program Checkout)
item.description: After WC discussion, coach triggers App Program payment link. User pays via /user/program endpoints.

request.description: Returns coach-triggered program offer or assigned program.

item.name: 09 - Profile Settings
item.description: Update user profile, phone, and WhatsApp.

request.description: Update profile fields. Use multipart for profile photo.

item.name: 10 - Heal Features (Post-unlock)
item.description: Sample Heal-tier feature APIs available after subscription.

item.name: A - Staff Prerequisites (Testing)
item.description: Staff/coach APIs needed to complete the user flow during testing. Use Account auth (not legacy /admin/auth).
